islamicart.home.artisticIntroductionText: Read curated introductions to the major artistic traditions of Islamic art, illustrated with monuments and objects from the collection.
islamicart.home.databaseText: Search the full inventory by name, location, provenance, material, patron and more. Combine up to three keyword fields.
islamicart.home.dynastiesText: Discover the dynasties and ruling periods of the Islamic world, and see the objects and monuments linked to each one.
islamicart.home.exhibitionsText: Discover curated virtual exhibitions exploring specific themes, monuments, and objects from the Islamic art collection.
islamicart.home.intro: Discover Islamic Art presents a wide range of objects and monuments from the Islamic world, held in museums and historic sites across numerous countries. Explore the collection through the Permanent Collection browser or the full-text Database search.
islamicart.home.partnersText: Meet the partner museums and institutions across the Islamic world that hold and share the objects and monuments in the collection.
islamicart.home.permanentCollectionText: Browse the collection by country, period / dynasty, holding institution, or date range.
islamicart.home.timelineText: Explore historical events by country and time period, and see the collection items linked to each period.

islamicart.partner.introDiscover: Discover Islamic Art is a collaborative project bringing together museums and institutions from across the Islamic world and beyond. Browse the partner museums that lend and hold the objects in the collection, or the partner institutions responsible for the monuments and historic sites.
islamicart.partner.introExplore: Explore Islamic Art Collections brings together further museums and institutions beyond the core Discover Islamic Art network.
